summary: Remove repeated local citation metadata from the QA V2 provider envelope while retaining exact evidence and local validation, expose a byte-only preflight, and force UTF-8 for clean Windows dependency-install children.
decision_refs: User authorized real API testing and directed the 64 KB blocker to be solved on 2026-10-09.
approval_evidence: The user explicitly allowed model calls, chose to solve the input blocker and attempt a fresh install, and requested resubmission after focusing on PDF.
known_limitations: Seven of fifteen live Flash answers passed the unchanged claim contract; eight were safely rejected, and no quality improvement is claimed.
QA V2 remains an independent path and the browser default is not cut over by this change.
Actual Windows DPAPI persistence and customer-data migration/restore were explicitly deferred; packaging, remote CI and deployment remain separate work.
